parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically colored differently for visibility and ergonomics.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to pump out the liquid (soap, shampoo, or lotion) from the container through the nozzle mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism inside the pump head.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head part connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and the base body, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal pump components and ensures the liquid is drawn up from the bottle and dispensed through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers the pressing motion from the lid to the internal pump mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of PET plastic, typically transparent or colored to show the liquid inside.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid product such as soap, shampoo, or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid being dispensed.
